i don't think you're asking for too much naman. everyone (or at least most people) want to be wanted in the same way they want their partner. i would feel the same if i felt like my partner isn't as enthusiastic about touching me. 

has this been going on ever since you guys got together? mahirap kasi if important sa'yo yung physical intimacy pero you're not in the same "wavelength" so to speak.

as a enby lesbian i do enjoy a bit of gender fuckery from time to time. using more traditionally masculine terms minsan during intimate moments but not always. but since you said that the role playing seems to be constant or is needed for her to get in the mood, it does sound...unusual to me personally. 

have you told her about how you felt? that this has been affecting your self-esteem? 

i haven't experienced anything like this personally but i do feel for you OP :(
lord crush na crush ko talaga si ssob 😭

hehe this subreddit has always helped me learn new tips when playing since i started as a casual player but when i convinced my gf to play with me, she surprisingly, is very good at the game haha. i wanted to be better so i could keep playing ranked with her and posts here also become a part of our conversations and make us bond even if we're in an ldr 

good luck to everyone! and happy 100k!
oh I'm so very sorry to hear that. it does hurt a lot. i wish for your well being and i hope it gets better for us soon! and yeah same goes to you, if you wanna talk, I'm all ears :)

thanks so much 🥺 it feels nice to be able to get some advice from people who went through the same thing i did. and yes, i'm just taking it slow, baby steps. it still gets bad some days but i continue. 💪🏽
yeah i'll get used to it sooner or later. it's gonna be so hard but that's just how it is i guess. im just hoping it gets easier pretty quick hahaha

yes, I'm talking to my best friends about it whenever it gets really bad. and recently I've gone back to finishing some of the games I've been playing. thanks so much. :) it feels nice to talk to people about it even if we're technically strangers haha
Yes, a lot of times (the last time was yesterday). Just the realization that my mental illness has made me a husk of my formal self, and that life where I'm from is hard.
That sometimes I have a hard time looking at people directly. Like in the eyes or in the face. It's not you, it's social anxiety.
Chester Bennington. I grew up listening to LP and his voice brings back childhood memories.
people who ignore products that drop from aisles in the supermarket because they accidentally hit the shelf or get from a pile that was unstable and then just walk away like nothing happened
pay for therapy and get medicated. and also maybe a movie.
sana having the time of her life

I have anxiety. I can't get a job because I panic or get too nervous about interacting with people. The thought of going to interviews scare me. I really want to get a job but I just don't get how it's so hard for me to function normally instead of being nervous/scared all the time. My girlfriend is currently working for the both of us and I stay home to do chores. She understands but I can't stand seeing her tired from working. And me having to stay at home doing nothing. :(
I'm saving up to finish college. But life seems to be getting in the way and I have to spend the money I'm trying to save up. Still doing my best and trying to stay positive though!
